LEARNING AT DEVOUR

Academics & Curriculum

Comprehensive schooling from Nursery to Class 10 in both English and Hindi Medium using official NCERT textbooks.

Learning at every stage

Parents can choose either English Medium or Hindi Medium for their child across all classes from Nursery to Class 10.

01

Pre-Primary (Nursery, LKG, UKG)

A warm, caring start focusing on phonics, early reading, number concepts, handwriting readiness, rhymes and joyful play.

02

Primary Wing (Classes 1 to 5)

Building strong habits in English, Hindi, Mathematics and Environmental Studies using official NCERT books and regular class practice.

03

Middle & Secondary (Classes 6 to 10)

In-depth subject mastery in Science, Mathematics, Social Science, English, Hindi and Sanskrit to prepare students for Class 10 Board examinations.

ADMISSION GUIDELINES

Simple & transparent admission process

Parents are welcome to visit our campus during school hours to meet the Principal and Director, tour the classrooms and playground, and complete registration.

Documents Required for Admission

  • Birth Certificate of the student (for Nursery to Class 1)
  • Transfer Certificate (TC) & Previous Report Card (Class 2 onwards)
  • Aadhaar Card copy of Student and Parents
  • 4 Passport-size photographs of the student
